gen.title: How water circulates between ground and atmosphere
gen.orderNote: Water returns to the atmosphere to begin the circulation again

steps.label: Liquid water evaporates to gas
steps.quote: Evaporation is the change of state in a substance from a liquid to a gas.

steps.label: Plants release water through transpiration
steps.quote: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from plants through stomata.

steps.label: Water vapor condenses into liquid
steps.quote: Condensation is the process whereby water vapor is changed into a liquid state.

steps.label: Water falls as precipitation
steps.quote: Precipitation is the primary way we receive fresh water on Earth.

steps.label: Excess water flows as runoff
steps.quote: Runoff occurs when there is excessive precipitation and the ground is saturated (cannot absorb any more water).
